messages:
Priya: Heads up  an early VIP (board member from Vega Partners) requested quiet arrival tomorrow at 08:15. Wants a private lobby couch area and minimal signage. Also mentioned two packages arriving tonight labeled 'CONFIDENTIAL'. Can we handle both?
frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-reg: Vega Board  1 guest, ETA 08:15. Quiet-arrival flag set. Pre-printed badge: white VIP. Reply 'confirm' to assign private seating.
Omar: We have a small side couch near the north alcove that can be roped off. Do we need additional privacy screens?
Kelsey: Put 'VIP - please wait' sign on a discrete easel instead of taped signage. Jorge from Facilities, can you bring a portable privacy screen and a small table?
Jorge: Can do. I'll drop a screen and folding table at 07:50 and leave the alcove roped. Also suggest we move the plant to avoid camera reflection.
mail-bot: Package inbound tonight at 22:10: 2 items labeled 'CONFIDENTIAL  Legal'. Sender: Vega Partners. Current location: Nighthold shelf A1.
Priya: Thanks. Please keep both packages in Nighthold A1 and DO NOT deliver to host. Only release to Priya or Security with pre-auth code. I'll take custody in the morning.
frontdesk-bot: Check-in instructions for VIP:
```
1) Quiet arrival: meet in foyer, no public announcement
2) Print white VIP badge, do not display company logos
3) Escort guest to north alcove -> roped private couch
4) Offer coffee tray; keep conversation low-volume
5) Packet pick-up: Priya to retrieve 'CONFIDENTIAL' packages from Nighthold A1
```
Omar: Also, the visiting guest asked for a spare phone charger and hypoallergenic snack (no nuts). Kelsey, can you pull a charger from the supplies box and order a nut-free snack box?
Kelsey: Got a USB-C + Lightning combo in cabinet 3. Ordering nut-free snacks to arrive by 07:45. Marking snack as "VIP ".
Ryan: One small note: if there's press or other visitors, keep them out of the foyer until the VIP departs. I'll coordinate with Ops on temporary signage.
Priya: Perfect. Final ask: no photos and no social media posting while guest is onsite. I'll add NDA/photography note in the arrival email.
frontdesk-bot: All set  Quiet-arrival, private seating reserved, packages in Nighthold A1, VIP badge ready. Security notified for 08:00 stand-by.
Priya: Thanks team  I'll confirm once packages are picked up and the guest has checked in.
